name: 83725 · Boise, ID
findings: ZIP 83725 (Boise) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 83725 (Boise) has 12 organizations listing opportunities in their tax returns or websites, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.
